task: speech emotion recognition, 6 classes (anger, disgust, fear, happy, neutral, sad)
features: WavLM base+ (microsoft/wavlm-base-plus), concat of layers 5, 7, 6, mean-pooled; logistic regression
data: CREMA-D (7,442 clips) + RAVDESS speech (1,056 clips, calm and surprised dropped); split by actor
note: acted speech only; real calls will score lower. Needs the same feature extraction as the notebook (predict_mood).
